material_systems.name: Flat/Matte Wall Paint
material_systems.description: Flat or matte finish wall paint for basic coverage. Hides imperfections well. Available at all quality tiers.

products.notes: Flat/matte hides surface imperfections. Default 1 coat for QT2, 2 coats for QT3+. Actual coat count specified in PaintScope.

material_systems.name: Eggshell Wall Paint
material_systems.description: Eggshell finish wall paint. Standard default for residential walls. Slight sheen provides durability and washability while hiding minor imperfections.

products.notes: Eggshell is the standard default sheen for walls. Provides better washability than flat while still hiding minor imperfections. Default 2 coats; actual coat count specified in PaintScope.

material_systems.name: Satin Wall Paint
material_systems.description: Satin finish wall paint. Requires QT4+ due to sheen revealing surface imperfections. Better durability and washability than eggshell.

products.notes: Satin requires QT4+ per Quality_Tiers_and_Surface_Condition.md. Higher sheen reveals imperfections; enhanced prep and sanding between coats required.

material_systems.name: Semi-Gloss Wall Paint
material_systems.description: Semi-gloss finish wall paint. Requires QT5 only due to sheen revealing surface imperfections. High durability and washability.

products.notes: Semi-gloss requires QT5. Full sanding between coats mandatory. Reveals surface imperfections significantly.

sheen_quality_tier_rules.description: Sheen availability is quality-tier restricted per Quality_Tiers_and_Surface_Condition.md

rules.notes: Lower sheens hide imperfections; available at any quality tier
Satin reveals imperfections; requires enhanced prep and sanding discipline
Semi-gloss magnifies imperfections; requires meticulous workmanship

sheen_quality_tier_rules.automatic_upgrade_rule: If specified sheen exceeds quality tier maximum, automatically upgrade quality tier per doctrine
sheen_quality_tier_rules.gloss_note: Gloss is NOT available for drywall walls. Gloss on drywall is not a real-world application.

coat_count_defaults.description: Default coat counts by quality tier. Actual coat count is specified in PaintScope and may differ from defaults.

QT2.notes: Economy tier tries for 1 coat but may require 2 if coverage not achieved. Coat count specified in PaintScope.

QT3.notes: Standard residential. Default 2 coats for uniform color depth and hide.

QT4.notes: Premium tier. Default 2 coats with full sand between coats.

QT5.notes: Showroom tier. Default 2 coats with full sand between coats and critical inspection.

coat_count_defaults.important: Coat count is NOT derived from quality tier. These are spec defaults only. Actual coat count comes from PaintScope specification. QT2 requiring 2 coats does NOT bump to QT3.

coverage_profiles.assumptions: Primed drywall wall, proper application thickness
Orange peel texture increases surface area, reduces coverage ~12%
Knockdown texture increases surface area, reduces coverage ~18%
Smooth surface recommended for satin at QT4+.
Orange peel texture with satin finish. Texture will be visible at this sheen.
Knockdown texture with satin finish. Texture will be visible at this sheen.
Smooth surface strongly recommended for semi-gloss. QT5 required.
Semi-gloss on textured walls is uncommon. Texture will be highly visible. Verify specification is intentional.

consumables.name: 18-inch roller cover, 3/8" to 1/2" nap
consumables.specification: 18-inch production roller cover, 3/8 to 1/2 inch nap range, synthetic blend
consumables.notes: 18" roller is standard for spray+backroll production. 3/8" to 1/2" nap range works for smooth AND textured walls (orange peel, knockdown). Do NOT use 3/4" nap for orange peel or knockdown.

consumables.name: 9-inch roller cover, 3/8" to 1/2" nap
consumables.specification: 9-inch standard roller cover, 3/8 to 1/2 inch nap range, synthetic blend
consumables.notes: Standard 9" roller for roll-only method or tight spaces during spray+backroll. 3/8" to 1/2" nap range for smooth AND textured walls. Do NOT use 3/4" nap for orange peel or knockdown.

consumables.name: 18-inch roller frame
consumables.specification: 18-inch production roller frame with threaded handle
consumables.notes: 18-inch frame is standard for production spray+backroll but not mandatory. 9-inch may be required for tight spaces.

consumables.name: 9-inch roller frame
consumables.specification: 9-inch standard roller frame with threaded handle
consumables.notes: Standard 9" frame for roll-only method or as backup for tight spaces during spray+backroll.

consumables.name: Extension pole
consumables.notes: Required for wall rolling and backrolling at standard and tall heights.

consumables.name: 5-gallon bucket with grid
consumables.notes: Standard for production wall work with spray+backroll.

consumables.name: Paint tray
consumables.notes: Tray with disposable liner for roll method.

consumables.name: Paint tray liner
consumables.notes: Replace each session or color change.

consumables.name: 2.5-inch angled brush
consumables.notes: Used for ceiling-line edge cut-in. Wall painter establishes ceiling line. Synthetic bristle for latex paint. ~3000 LF with proper care.

consumables.name: Spray tip 415
consumables.notes: 415 tip is typical for wall finish paint. Smaller fan and orifice than primer tips for better atomization on finish coats.

consumables.name: Spray tip 413
consumables.notes: 413 tip alternative for wall finish paint. Slightly smaller orifice for finer atomization.

consumables.name: Spray gun filter
consumables.specification: In-line filter for airless spray gun
consumables.notes: Replace when clogged or every ~50 gallons.

consumables.name: Rosin paper
consumables.notes: Full floor coverage for hard floors during wall spray. Taped seams required per Protection_and_Masking_Doctrine.

consumables.name: Plastic sheeting 1.5 mil
consumables.specification: 1.5 mil plastic sheeting for floor protection
consumables.notes: Full floor coverage for carpet during wall spray. Taped edges required.

consumables.name: Canvas drop cloth
consumables.notes: Reusable floor perimeter protection for roll method. Positioned along base of walls being rolled.

consumables.name: Blue painter's tape 1.5-inch
consumables.notes: Standard blue tape for trim edge masking, floor seams. 180 LF (60 yards) per roll. This spec owns the trim masking step.

consumables.name: Green edge-seal tape
consumables.specification: Green edge-seal painter's tape (e.g., Frog Tape), 1.5-inch width
consumables.notes: Green edge-seal tape for crisp paint lines at QT4+. Requires damp rag edge seal per Materials_and_Consumables_Doctrine tape technique.

consumables.name: Sandpaper 220 grit
consumables.notes: For sanding between finish coats. Full sand at QT4+. 220 grit is standard per Quality_Tiers_and_Surface_Condition.md.

consumables.name: Pole sander
consumables.specification: Pole sander head for extension pole
consumables.notes: Pole sander for wall sanding between coats at QT4+.

consumables.description: Finish paint material quantity based on wall field area and coat count
consumables.notes: Select coverage profile based on material system and surface texture. Coat count from PaintScope specification (defaults by QT if not specified). Add 5-10% waste factor for spray methods.

consumables.description: Brush for ceiling line cut-in (wall painter establishes ceiling line)
consumables.notes: 1 brush per material type minimum. Wall painter establishes ceiling line via freehand cut-in.

consumables.description: Roller cover replacement based on wall area and coat count
consumables.notes: Driven by product count and color count per Materials_and_Consumables_Doctrine. Use 3/8" to 1/2" nap range for all wall textures (smooth, orange peel, knockdown). Roller size: 18" is standard for spray_backroll, 9" for roll-only or tight spaces.

consumables.description: Floor protection material for spray/spray_backroll methods
consumables.notes: Rosin paper for hard floors, plastic sheeting for carpet. Material selection driven by floor_type site condition.

consumables.description: Floor protection (perimeter drops) for roll method
consumables.formula: Reusable drop cloths positioned along wall perimeter.
consumables.notes: Canvas drops for roll method. Less material than spray full-floor coverage.

consumables.description: Tape for masking trim edges before wall finish application. This spec owns the trim masking step.
consumables.notes: Blue tape standard; green edge-seal tape at QT4+ for crisp lines. Wall finish spec OWNS the trim masking task - when painting finish on drywall walls, you always have to mask the trim.

consumables.description: Sandpaper for between-coat sanding at QT4+
consumables.notes: Full sand between coats at QT4+ only. 220 grit per Quality_Tiers_and_Surface_Condition.md Sanding Standards.

compatibility_rules.description: Latex/acrylic wall paint is fully compatible with latex primers (PVA, acrylic latex)
compatibility_rules.notes: All wall finish systems are latex/acrylic, compatible with NC drywall primers.

compatibility_rules.description: Sheen selection is gated by quality tier
compatibility_rules.constraint: Flat/matte/eggshell at any QT; satin at QT4+; semi-gloss at QT5 only; gloss NOT available for drywall walls
compatibility_rules.notes: Per Quality_Tiers_and_Surface_Condition.md. Higher sheens reveal imperfections. Gloss is not a real-world application for drywall.

compatibility_rules.description: Roller nap selection for drywall walls
compatibility_rules.constraint: Use 3/8" to 1/2" nap for smooth, orange peel, and knockdown textures. Do NOT use 3/4" nap for orange peel or knockdown.
compatibility_rules.notes: 3/4" nap is only appropriate for very porous concrete, stomp texture, or popcorn ceilings. See doctrine_conflicts for pending doctrine update.

compatibility_rules.description: 18-inch roller is standard for spray+backroll but not mandatory
compatibility_rules.constraint: 18-inch increases throughput; 9-inch may be required for tight spaces between obstacles
compatibility_rules.notes: Per Materials_and_Consumables_Doctrine, 18-inch increases backroll throughput, but practical constraints may require 9-inch.

risk_notes.description: Semi-gloss finish on walls reveals surface imperfections. Requires QT5 workmanship, critical inspection, and meticulous prep.
risk_notes.mitigation: Verify semi-gloss specification is intentional. Full sand between coats mandatory. Ensure controlled environment during application.

risk_notes.description: Satin at QT4+ requires enhanced prep. If prep is insufficient, sheen will reveal flaws not visible with eggshell.
risk_notes.mitigation: Full sand between coats. Thorough inspection before each coat.

risk_notes.description: Textured walls (orange peel, knockdown) with high sheen (satin+) will show texture prominently. This is usually undesirable.
risk_notes.mitigation: Verify specification is intentional. Recommend smooth walls for satin+ sheens.

risk_notes.description: Wall finish coat application risks lap marks if wet edge is not maintained. More visible at higher sheens.
risk_notes.mitigation: Maintain wet edge during application. Work in sections. Spray+backroll reduces lap mark risk vs roll-only.

risk_notes.description: Wall painter establishes ceiling line via cut-in. Line quality must match quality tier standards. Ceiling line bleed is a common failure mode.
risk_notes.mitigation: Use quality brushes. Proper loading technique. Steady hand. Touch-up with ceiling paint if wall paint bleeds onto ceiling.

assumptions.value: Same base coverage rates as ceiling finish (400 SF/gal smooth) adjusted for texture
assumptions.note: Wall and ceiling coverage rates are equivalent for same texture.
No doctrine coverage for spray waste factor. Wall spray waste may be slightly less than ceiling due to more directional overspray pattern.

assumptions.value: Wall finish spec owns trim masking task
assumptions.note: When painting finish on drywall walls, you always have to mask the trim. This task belongs to wall finish spec, not trim spec.

uncertainty_flags.description: Green edge-seal tape usage at QT4+ is recommended but painter discretion applies. Some painters achieve crisp lines with blue tape.
Spray tip selection (413 vs 415) for wall finish varies by product viscosity. PDS is authoritative.

doctrine_conflicts.doctrine_says: Medium texture (knockdown) = 3/4" nap; Light texture (orange peel) = 1/2" nap
doctrine_conflicts.research_says: For drywall walls with orange peel or knockdown texture, use 1/2" nap. Do NOT use 3/4" nap. 3/4" nap is only appropriate for very porous concrete, stomp texture, or popcorn ceilings.
doctrine_conflicts.research_source: Field contractor review (30 years experience), Review Notes 2026-02-04

options.B: Use research: 1/2" nap for knockdown and orange peel
options.C: Update doctrine to match research - differentiate between drywall textures and heavy textures (concrete, stomp, popcorn)

doctrine_conflicts.recommendation: Option C - Update Materials_and_Consumables_Doctrine.md to clarify: 3/8" to 1/2" nap for all standard drywall textures (smooth, orange peel, knockdown); 3/4" nap reserved for very porous concrete, stomp texture, popcorn ceilings only.
doctrine_conflicts.resolution: Doctrine updated 2026-02-04. Materials_and_Consumables_Doctrine.md Nap Thickness Selection table now correctly specifies 1/2" nap for knockdown drywall.
doctrine_conflicts.note: This correction also needs to be applied to other specs that reference roller nap by texture (SF_DRYWALL_CEILING_NC_FINISH, SF_DRYWALL_WALL_NC_PRIME, SF_DRYWALL_CEILING_NC_PRIME, etc.)

research_corrections.title: No spot-priming NC drywall fasteners
research_corrections.impact: No spot-prime tasks needed - fasteners are mudded and not exposed

research_corrections.title: Do not specify dry times in specs
research_corrections.impact: No dry time references in materials - refer to PDS

research_corrections.title: Gloss not available for drywall walls
research_corrections.impact: Removed SYS_WALL_GLOSS system. Gloss on drywall is not a real-world application.

research_corrections.title: Semi-gloss gated at QT5 only
research_corrections.impact: SYS_WALL_SEMI_GLOSS applies_when changed from QT4+ to QT5 only.

research_corrections.title: Coat count not derived from QT
research_corrections.impact: Coat count is specified in PaintScope, not derived from quality tier. QT has defaults but actual coat count can differ. QT2 requiring 2 coats does NOT auto-bump to QT3.

research_corrections.title: Spray tip size for wall finish is 413-415
research_corrections.impact: Changed from 515/517 to 413/415 for wall finish paint. Smaller tips for finish vs primer.

research_corrections.title: 18-inch roller not mandatory for spray+backroll
research_corrections.impact: 18-inch is standard/preferred but not mandatory. 9-inch may be required for tight spaces.

research_corrections.title: Wall finish spec owns trim masking task
research_corrections.impact: Trim masking is not a pre-condition from trim spec. When painting finish on drywall walls, you always have to mask the trim - this spec owns that task.
